abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.desc: Ambush the target, causing 250% weapon damage plus 290 to the target. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Cheap Shot
abilities.desc: Stuns the target for 4 sec. Must be stealthed. Awards 2 combo points.

abilities.name: Cold Blood
abilities.desc: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

abilities.name: Eviscerate
abilities.desc:
Finishing move that causes damage per combo point, increased by Attack Power:
 1 point : 224-332 damage
 2 points: 394-502 damage
 3 points: 564-672 damage
 4 points: 734-842 damage
 5 points: 904-1,012 damage

abilities.name: Expose Armor
abilities.desc:
Finishing move that exposes the target for 30 sec, reducing Armor per combo point:
 1 point : 450 Armor
 2 points: 900 Armor
 3 points: 1,350 Armor
 4 points: 1,800 Armor
 5 points: 2,250 Armor

abilities.name: Garrote
abilities.desc: Garrote the enemy, causing 552 damage over 18 sec, increased by your Attack Power. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Kidney Shot
abilities.desc:
Finishing move that stuns the target. Lasts longer per combo point:
 1 point : 2 seconds
 2 points: 3 seconds
 3 points: 4 seconds
 4 points: 5 seconds
 5 points: 6 seconds

abilities.name: Mutilate
abilities.desc: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 75% weapon damage plus an additional 38 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.

abilities.name: Rupture
abilities.desc:
Finishing move that causes damage over time, increased by your Attack Power. Lasts longer per combo point:
 1 point : 159 damage over 8 secs
 2 points: 222 damage over 10 secs
 3 points: 295 damage over 12 secs
 4 points: 377 damage over 14 secs
 5 points: 469 damage over 16 secs

abilities.name: Slice and Dice
abilities.desc:
Finishing move that increases melee attack speed by 30%. Lasts longer per combo point:
 1 point : 9 seconds
 2 points: 12 seconds
 3 points: 15 seconds
 4 points: 18 seconds
 5 points: 21 seconds

abilities.name: Venom
abilities.desc:
Finishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point:
 1 point : 9 sec
 2 points: 12 sec
 3 points: 15 sec
 4 points: 18 sec
 5 points: 21 sec

abilities.name: Adrenaline Rush
abilities.desc: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Backstab
abilities.desc: Backstab the target, causing 150% weapon damage plus 225 to the target. Must be behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Blade Flurry
abilities.desc: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Evasion
abilities.desc: The rogue's dodge chance will increase by 50% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Feint
abilities.desc: Performs a feint, causing no damage but lowering your threat by a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

abilities.name: Gouge
abilities.desc: Causes 75 damage, stops your attack, and incapacitates the target for 4 sec. The target must be facing you. Any damage taken will break the effect. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Kick
abilities.desc: A quick kick that injures a single foe for 80 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.desc: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Sinister Strike
abilities.desc: An instant strike that causes 68 damage in addition to your normal weapon damage. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Sprint
abilities.desc: Increases the rogue's movement speed by 70% for 15 sec. Does not break stealth.

abilities.name: Blind
abilities.desc: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for up to 10 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect.

abilities.name: Disarm Trap
abilities.desc: Sneak up on the trap in order to disarm it. Don't get too close or the trap will go off.

abilities.name: Distract
abilities.desc: Throws a distraction, attracting the attention of all nearby enemies and reducing their Stealth detection as if they were 1 level lower for 10 seconds. Does not break stealth.

abilities.name: Ghostly Strike
abilities.desc: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage and increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Hemorrhage
abilities.desc: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.

abilities.name: Pick Pocket
abilities.desc: Pick the target's pocket.

abilities.name: Premeditation
abilities.desc: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

abilities.name: Preparation
abilities.desc: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

abilities.name: Sap
abilities.desc: Incapacitates the target for up to 45 sec. Only works on Humanoids that are not in combat. Any damage taken will break the effect. Only 1 target may be sapped at a time. Does not break Stealth.

abilities.name: Stealth
abilities.desc: Allows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 30%. Lasts until cancelled.

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.desc: Allows the rogue to vanish from sight, entering an improved stealth mode for 10 sec. Also breaks movement impairing effects. More effective than Vanish (Rank 1).

abilities.name: Crippling Poison
lines: Reagents: Essence of Agony x3, Crystal Vial
abilities.desc: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 30 minutes. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, slowing their movement speed by 70% for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Instant Poison
lines: Reagents: Dust of Deterioration x4, Crystal Vial
abilities.desc: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 30 minutes. Each strike has a 20% chance of poisoning the enemy which instantly inflicts 76 to 100 Nature damage. 175 charges.

abilities.name: Mind-numbing Poison
lines: Reagents: Dust of Deterioration x2, Essence of Agony x2, Crystal Vial
abilities.desc: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 30 minutes. Each strike has a 20% chance of poisoning the enemy, increasing their casting time by 60% for 14 sec. 150 charges.

abilities.name: Deadly Poison
abilities.desc: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 30 minutes. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy for 92 Nature damage over 12 sec. Stacks up to 5 times on a single target. 180 charges.

abilities.name: Wound Poison
lines: Reagents: Essence of Agony x2, Deathweed x2, Crystal Vial
abilities.desc: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 30 minutes. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, reducing all healing effects used on them by 165 for 15 sec. Stacks up to 5 times on a single target. 160 charges.

abilities.name: Blinding Powder
abilities.desc: Create the reagent for the Blind ability.

abilities.name: Pick Lock
abilities.desc: Allows opening of locked chests and doors.

abilities.name: Throw
abilities.desc: Hurl a thrown weapon at the target.

abilities.name: Blood Fury
abilities.desc: Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Shatter Curse
abilities.desc: Instantly removes all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 5% for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Will of the Forsaken
abilities.desc: Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

abilities.name: Cannibalize
abilities.desc: When activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: Berserking
abilities.desc: Increases your spellcasting and attack speed by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Rapid Regeneration
abilities.desc: Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec. Any movement, action, or damage taken will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: Walk on Air
abilities.desc: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

abilities.name: Skysight
abilities.desc: Increases your movement speed by 15% for 15 sec. Used at an elemental convergence it also grants Charged for 1 hour, which raises the bonus to 30%. Charged persists through death and ends when you enter a raid.

abilities.name: Perception
abilities.desc: Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Will to Survive
abilities.desc: Instantly removes all Stun effects.

abilities.name: Find Treasure
abilities.desc: Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap.  Lasts until canceled.

abilities.name: Stoneform
abilities.desc: Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Shadowmeld
abilities.desc: Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.

abilities.name: Elune's Light
abilities.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Escape Artist
abilities.desc: Instantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Eureka!
abilities.desc: For 8 sec, your non-periodic damaging abilities cost 10% less (Mana, Rage or Energy) and deal 10% more damage. For Priests, your non-periodic damaging or healing abilities cost 10% less Mana and do 10% more damage or healing. Periodic effects get nothing from it; a channeled spell is not periodic. The Mage's own tooltip is the one that leaves out non-periodic.

abilities.name: Walk on Air
abilities.desc: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

abilities.name: Read Leyline
abilities.desc: Increases your Health and Mana regeneration by 50% for 15 sec. Used at a Ley Line it also grants Attuned for 1 hour, which raises the bonus to 100%. Attuned persists through death and ends when you enter a raid. Cannot be used while Innervate is active.
